name: OpenAdapt
description: Turns a recorded demonstration of a GUI task into a replayable automation that verifies its own effects.
whatItDoes: Lets a person show a workflow once and then have it repeated automatically, targeting repetitive back-office work. The compiled automation checks that each step had the intended outcome instead of blindly replaying clicks.
howItWorks: A recorder captures the demonstration, a compiler converts it into a program, and a runtime replays that program without needing a model in the loop for each step. A doctor command checks the chosen backend, a tutorial flow walks through the pipeline, and an agent server can expose runs to other tools.
models: Not needed for the tutorial; model use is optional
